procedural_matters: Upon receipt of a report from the Jury boat on the ILCA 4 race area, the International Jury decided to call a hearing under RRS 62.1 to consider whether a support person had broken a rule.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GER 215510 and Coach Bruno Schultze did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
Jury was represented by Adrian Bauder.
facts: Bruno Schultze was driving support person vessel 266 on 28 June 2025.

Approximatly two and half minutes before the starting signal of race 7 and about 15 - 20 meters from the starting line close to the starting vessel, Bruno Schultze was observed approaching GER 215510, talking to her and picking up a bag.
At the start the Race Committee signaled a general recall.
conclusions: GER 215510 received help from an outside source, and broke RRS 41. Because the race was general recalled no penalty is imposed.
Bruno Schultze broke Event Support Team Regulation 5.1.1 and 5.1.2.
decision: Bruno Schultze must be anchored during the starting procedure of all the ILCA 4 races of the day 29 of June.
